'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Sandro Botticelli]]'s ''[[Portrait of a Young Man Holding a Roundel]]'' is sold at [[auction]] for [[United States dollar|$]]92.2 million at [[Sotheby's]] in [[New York City]], making it the [[List of most expensive paintings|second most expensive painting]] by an [[old master]] ever sold at public auction. [https://www.nst.com.my/world/world/2021/01/661395/botticelli-painting-sells-rm3725-million-auction (AFP via ''New Straits Times'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]], [[COVID-19 recession]]
***The [[Philippines]]' [[gross domestic product|GDP]] [[Recession|contracts]] 9.5% in 2020, its first annual contraction since 1998 following the [[1997 Asian financial crisis]] and the country's worst [[economy of the Philippines|economic performance]] since records began in 1947. [https://asia.nikkei.com/Economy/Philippines-GDP-shrinks-9.5-in-2020-worst-since-1947 (''Nikkei Asia'')]
**[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]], [[COVID-19 recession]]
***The [[United States]]'s [[gross domestic product|GDP]] [[Recession|contracts]] 3.5% in 2020, its first annual contraction since 2009 following the [[financial crisis of 2007–2008]] and the country's worst [[Economy of the United States|economic performance]] since 1946. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-economy/covid-19-pummels-u-s-economy-in-2020-performance-weakest-in-74-years-idUSKBN29X0I8 (Reuters)]
**[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on tourism]]
***The [[World Tourism Organization]] reports that the [[International tourism|global]] [[tourism]] sector lost [[United States dollar|$]]1.3 trillion in revenue in 2020, calling it "the worst year in tourism history". The organization attributes the loss to [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/coronavirus/1611847754-un-virus-cost-global-tourism-1-3-trillion-in-2020 (AFP via i24NEWS)]
*[[GameStop short squeeze]]
**[[GameStop]] stock briefly tops US$500 before dropping 36% from Wednesday's closing. Trading was halted multiple times due to the climb and the crash. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/01/28/gamestop-reverses-losses-and-surges-another-30percent-in-the-premarket-to-450-as-mania-continues.html?scrlybrkr=8b0d5a96 (CNBC)]
**[[Robinhood (company)|Robinhood]], [[TD Ameritrade]], and [[Webull]] restrict the trade of heavily [[short (finance)|shorted]] stocks such as [[GameStop]], [[AMC Theatres|AMC]], [[BlackBerry]], [[Nokia]], and [[Koss Corporation|Koss]] on their platforms. [https://www.cnet.com/personal-finance/robinhood-app-td-ameritrade-restrict-trading-of-gamestop-amc-stock/ (CNET)]
**A [[class action]] lawsuit was filed against [[Robinhood (company)|Robinhood]] in response to shutting down the buying of stocks at the center of the short squeeze. [[United States House of Representatives|US Representative]] [[Rashida Tlaib]] ([[Democratic Party (United States)|D]]-[[Michigan|MI]]) has called for an investigation into the ban on stock sales. [https://www.newsweek.com/robinhood-under-assault-all-sides-gamestop-1565312 (''Newsweek'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Georgia poultry plant accident]]
**Six people are killed and nine others hospitalized due to a leak of [[liquid nitrogen]] at a poultry plant in [[Gainesville, Georgia]], United States. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-55847100 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Arizona]]
*****[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Navajo Nation]]
******The [[Navajo Nation]] surpasses 1,000 deaths from COVID-19. [https://www.azcentral.com/story/news/local/arizona-health/2021/01/28/navajo-nation-reaches-1000-covid-19-deaths/4303343001/ (''The Arizona Republic'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Carolina]], [[501.V2 variant]]
*****[[South Carolina]] reports the United States' first two cases of the 501.V2 variant first detected in [[South Africa]] in people with no known travel history. [https://www.npr.org/sections/coronavirus-live-updates/2021/01/28/961609976/south-carolina-reports-1st-known-u-s-cases-of-variant-from-south-africa (NPR)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]]
****[[Mexico]] surpasses [[India]] to have the third-highest death toll in the world. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-mexico-casualties/mexicos-covid-19-death-toll-surpasses-india-becomes-worlds-third-highest-idUSKBN29Y066 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal]] reports new daily records for both cases and deaths, with 16,432 new cases and 303 deaths, bringing the nationwide cumulative totals to 685,383 confirmed cases and 11,608 deaths. [https://covid19.min-saude.pt/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/332_DGS_boletim_20210128.pdf (DGS)]
****The [[Government of Portugal|government]] announces the closure of its border with [[Spain]] for two weeks beginning January 31. [https://www.elperiodico.com/es/internacional/20210128/portugal-cierra-frontera-espana-dos-semanas-11483377 (''El Periódico'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Andorra]]
****The number of deaths from COVID-19 in [[Andorra]] reaches 100. [https://www.andorradifusio.ad/noticies/andorra-100-morts-covid-19 (''Andorra Difusió'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]], [[501.V2 variant]]
****Spain reports their first case of the 501.V2 variant in a 30-year-old man who travelled from [[South Africa]] to [[Vigo]]. [https://www.abc.es/espana/galicia/abci-detectado-vigo-primer-caso-confirmado-variante-sudafricana-202101281800_noticia.html (ABC.es)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****The [[Ecumenical Patriarch of Constantinople]] [[Bartholomew I]] receives the first dose of the COVID-19 vaccine. [https://greekcitytimes.com/2021/01/28/ecumenical-patriarch-bartholomew/ (''Greek City Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports a record 476 deaths in the past 24 hours, 200 of which are from [[West Java]], bringing the nationwide death toll to 29,331. [https://kabar24.bisnis.com/read/20210128/15/1349261/hari-ini-jabar-catat-penambahan-4532-kasus-covid-19 (Bisnis)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] reports a record 113 deaths in the past 24 hours. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2021/01/28/national/tokyo-covid19-cases-above-1000/ (''The Japan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Food and Drug Administration (Philippines)|Food and Drug Administration]] approves the [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford-AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] for emergency use in the [[Philippines]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-01-28/philippines-approves-astrazeneca-vaccine-for-emergency-use (Bloomberg)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]]
****[[Vietnam]] reports their first two locally transmitted [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] cases in 55 days in [[Hải Dương Province|Hải Dương]] and [[Quảng Ninh Province|Quảng Ninh]] provinces, with one of them linked to the [[Variant of Concern 202012/01|B.1.1.7 variant]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-01-28/vietnam-reports-first-locally-transmitted-covid-cases-in-55-days/13099464 (ABC Australia)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Morocco]]
****[[Morocco]] begins its COVID-19 vaccination campaign with [[King of Morocco|King]] [[Mohammed VI of Morocco|Mohammed VI]] receiving the first dose. [https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2021/01/333587/king-mohammed-vi-receives-moroccos-1st-dose-of-covid-19-vaccine/ (Morocco World News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Senegal]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Senegal]] reports their first case of a more contagious variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] that originated in the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://news.yahoo.com/senegal-detects-first-case-british-175849075.html (AFP via Yahoo News)]
***[[Africa]] secures another 400 million doses of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://apnews.com/article/africa-kenya-coronavirus-pandemic-coronavirus-vaccine-3c001456cc095daa3c3a9de72944161e (AP)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]], [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
***[[Australia]] extends the suspension of their travel bubble with [[New Zealand]] for another 72 hours due to concerns about new [[variants of SARS-CoV-2]]. [https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/australia-extends-suspension-of-new-zealand-travel-bubble-for-another-72-hours/EDE6NIA4CAGJ2WD5LCUH3CUXMI/ (''NZ Herald'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]] surpasses nine million cases of COVID-19, becoming the third country to do so after [[India]] and the [[United States]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-brazil-numbers-idUSKBN29X2WY (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***Vaccine developer [[Novavax]] announces that [[Novavax COVID-19 vaccine|their vaccine candidate]] is 89% effective in preventing severe COVID-19, based on trial data from the United Kingdom; their vaccine was less effective against [[501.V2 variant|new variants of the virus]], based on data from South Africa. [https://www.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-vaccines-novavax-idUSKBN29X2WU (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Decolonisation of Africa]]
**[[Chagos Archipelago sovereignty dispute]]
***The [[United Nations]]' [[International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea]] rules that the [[United Kingdom]] has no legal sovereignty over the [[Chagos Archipelago]], and must return control of the islands back to [[Mauritius]]. The [[British Foreign Office]] rejects the ruling, saying that "Mauritius has never held sovereignty over the [[British Indian Ocean Territory]] and the UK does not recognise its claim". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-55848126 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on long-term care facilities]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)]]
**[[Attorney General of New York|New York Attorney General]] [[Letitia James]] releases a report accusing the [[New York (state)|state]] of undercounting the number of COVID-19 deaths in [[nursing home|nursing homes]]. [https://apnews.com/article/new-york-nursing-home-coronavirus-deaths-a6c214f4467976efdfca9ba75f8adaef (AP)]
*[[Social impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Lebanon]]
**One protester is shot dead and many more are wounded after attempting to storm a government building during an anti-lockdown riot in [[Tripoli, Lebanon|Tripoli]], [[Lebanon]]. The municipality building was set on fire before protesters pulled back to the city's main square. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-lebanon-protests/in-locked-down-lebanon-protester-killed-in-night-of-unrest-idUSKBN29X17J?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Politics of Kyrgyzstan]]
**[[Sadyr Japarov]] is sworn in as [[President of Kyrgyzstan|President]] of [[Kyrgyzstan]]. [https://eurasianet.org/kyrgyzstan-japarov-sworn-in-as-president-pledges-justice-and-prosperity (Eurasianet)]
 
'''Science and technology'''
*[[Criticism of Google]]
**[[Google]] removes major [[Australia]]n news sites from some of its search results in an "experiment" in reaction to the [[government of Australia|Australian government]]'s calls for Google to pay these sites for their content. [https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2021/jan/28/important-stories-hidden-in-googles-experiment-blocking-australian-news-sites (''The Guardian'')]
**The [[Australian Competition and Consumer Commission]] releases a report accusing Google of misusing its [[advertisement]] system to promote [[Alphabet Inc.]]'s own financial interests. [https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2021/jan/28/australian-watchdog-warns-google-may-be-misusing-its-market-power-in-91bn-online-ad-market (''The Guardian'')]
